# Pagination

A toolbar for navigating a paged dataset: current page and total, prev/next, a go-to-page field and a rows-per-page select. Each addon is toggled by a show* boolean, from a bare bar to a full footer.

```tsx
function Example() {
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1)
  const [rowsPerPage, setRowsPerPage] = useState(20)

  return (
    <Pagination
      page={page}
      pageCount={24}
      onPageChange={setPage}
      rowsPerPage={rowsPerPage}
      onRowsPerPageChange={setRowsPerPage}
      showInfo
      showControls
      showGoTo
      showRowsPerPage
    />
  )
}
```

## Installation

```bash
# One-time setup (tokens + lib helpers)
npx koalaui-cli@latest init

# Add this component (its dependencies come along)
npx koalaui-cli@latest add pagination
```

Manual: run `npm install radix-ui tailwind-variants tailwind-merge`, then copy the source into `components/ui/pagination/` and adjust the import paths to your project. Components pull `cn` from `lib/utils`, the `tv` wrapper from `lib/tv`, and (for multi-part components) `createContext` from `lib/create-context`.

## Usage

```tsx title="usage.tsx"
import { Pagination } from "@/components/ui/pagination"

export function Example() {
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1)

  return (
    <Pagination
      page={page}
      pageCount={10}
      onPageChange={setPage}
    />
  )
}
```

## Anatomy

```tsx
import {
  PaginationRoot,
  PaginationRowsPerPage,
  PaginationInfo,
  PaginationGoTo,
  PaginationControls,
  PaginationPrevButton,
  PaginationNextButton,
} from "@/components/ui/pagination"

<PaginationRoot page={…} pageCount={…}>
  <PaginationRowsPerPage />
  <PaginationInfo />
  <PaginationGoTo />
  <PaginationControls />
  {/* or the buttons one by one */}
  <PaginationPrevButton />
  <PaginationNextButton />
</PaginationRoot>
```

## Default

Out of the box you get the page readout and prev/next controls. The component is fully controlled: drive it with `page` and `onPageChange`. The buttons disable themselves at the first and last page.

```tsx
<Pagination page={page} pageCount={10} onPageChange={setPage} />
```

## Go to page

Set `showGoTo` to add a numeric field for jumping to an arbitrary page. The value commits on `Enter` or blur and is clamped into range, so an out-of-bounds entry snaps back to the nearest valid page.

```tsx
<Pagination
  page={page}
  pageCount={50}
  onPageChange={setPage}
  showGoTo
/>
```

## Rows per page

Set `showRowsPerPage` and wire `rowsPerPage` / `onRowsPerPageChange` to let users choose how many rows to load. Customize the choices with `rowsPerPageOptions`.

```tsx
<Pagination
  page={page}
  pageCount={12}
  onPageChange={setPage}
  rowsPerPage={rowsPerPage}
  onRowsPerPageChange={setRowsPerPage}
  rowsPerPageOptions={[10, 25, 50, 100]}
  showRowsPerPage
/>
```

## Density

Like the rest of Koala, Pagination honors the `density` axis (prop or `DensityProvider`). The whole toolbar lands on one matched control height: a 40px row when comfortable, a 32px row when compact.

```tsx
<Pagination density="comfortable" page={page} pageCount={16} onPageChange={setPage} showGoTo />
<Pagination density="compact" page={page} pageCount={16} onPageChange={setPage} showGoTo />
```

## Custom layout

For a bespoke arrangement, drop the `show*` toggles and compose the parts yourself inside `PaginationRoot`. Every part: `PaginationInfo`, `PaginationControls`, `PaginationGoTo`, `PaginationRowsPerPage`, reads the shared state from context.

```tsx
<PaginationRoot page={page} pageCount={20} onPageChange={setPage}>
  <PaginationControls />
  <PaginationInfo />
  <PaginationGoTo label="Jump to" />
</PaginationRoot>
```

## API reference

### Pagination

The ready toolbar: `PaginationRoot` with a default layout gated by `show*` toggles. Pass `children` to replace the layout. Every part accepts `className`, merged last.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| page* | number | - | The current page, 1-based. Fully controlled. |
| pageCount* | number | - | Total pages, clamped to at least 1. |
| onPageChange | (page: number) => void | - | Called with the next page, already clamped into range. |
| rowsPerPage | number | - | The current rows-per-page value, needed by the rows select. |
| onRowsPerPageChange | (rows: number) => void | - | Called with the next rows-per-page value. |
| rowsPerPageOptions | number[] | [10, 20, 30, 50] | The choices the rows select offers. |
| disabled | boolean | false | Disables every control at once. |
| density | "comfortable" \| "compact" | - | One matched control height: 40px comfortable, 32px compact. Inherits the nearest `DensityProvider` (compact with none). |
| showInfo | boolean | true | The `Page X of Y` readout. |
| showControls | boolean | true | The previous and next buttons. |
| showGoTo | boolean | false | The go-to-page field. |
| showRowsPerPage | boolean | false | The rows-per-page select. |

### PaginationRoot

The state provider and `<nav aria-label="Pagination">`, for a custom layout of the parts. Forwards native `<nav>` props.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| page* | number | - | The current page, 1-based. Fully controlled. |
| pageCount* | number | - | Total pages, clamped to at least 1. |
| onPageChange | (page: number) => void | - | Called with the next page, already clamped into range. |
| rowsPerPage | number | - | The current rows-per-page value, needed by the rows select. |
| onRowsPerPageChange | (rows: number) => void | - | Called with the next rows-per-page value. |
| rowsPerPageOptions | number[] | [10, 20, 30, 50] | The choices the rows select offers. |
| disabled | boolean | false | Disables every control at once. |
| density | "comfortable" \| "compact" | - | One matched control height: 40px comfortable, 32px compact. Inherits the nearest `DensityProvider` (compact with none). |

### PaginationInfo

The `Page X of Y` readout, `aria-live="polite"`, numbers in `tabular-nums`. `children` replace the copy, e.g. to localize. Forwards native `<p>` props.

### PaginationControls

The previous and next buttons with the cluster's spacing. Forwards native `<div>` props.

### PaginationPrevButton

The outline icon button to the previous page, disabled on the first. Forwards `Button` props but `size`, `variant` and `iconOnly`; `children` replace the caret.

### PaginationNextButton

The same button to the next page, disabled on the last.

### PaginationGoTo

A numeric field that jumps to a page on Enter or blur, clamped into range. Forwards native `<div>` props.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| label | React.ReactNode | "Go to" | The label before the field. `null` hides it. |

### PaginationRowsPerPage

The rows-per-page select, fed by the root's `rowsPerPage` and `rowsPerPageOptions`. Forwards native `<div>` props.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| label | React.ReactNode | "Rows per page" | The label before the select. `null` hides it. |

## FAQ

### Is Pagination controlled or uncontrolled?

It is fully controlled. Drive it with `page` and `pageCount` and update your state in `onPageChange`; the prev/next controls disable themselves automatically at the first and last page.

### How do I turn the extra pieces on?

Each addon is gated by a `show*` boolean: `showInfo` for the page readout, `showControls` for prev/next, `showGoTo` for the jump field, and `showRowsPerPage` for the rows-per-page select. That lets the same component be a bare prev/next bar or a full data-table footer.

### What happens if someone types an out-of-range page in the go-to field?

With `showGoTo`, the value commits on Enter or blur and is clamped into range, so an out-of-bounds entry snaps back to the nearest valid page.

### How do I wire the rows-per-page select?

Set `showRowsPerPage` and pass `rowsPerPage` with `onRowsPerPageChange`. Customize the choices with `rowsPerPageOptions`, for example `[10, 25, 50, 100]`.

### Can I build a custom layout from the parts?

Yes. Drop the `show*` toggles and compose `PaginationInfo`, `PaginationControls`, `PaginationGoTo`, and `PaginationRowsPerPage` yourself inside `PaginationRoot`; every part reads the shared state from context.

### Does Pagination respect density?

Yes. The `density` prop (or a surrounding DensityProvider) lands the whole toolbar on one matched control height: a 40px row when comfortable and a 32px row when compact.
